about_the_game:
Project Mercenaria is a lightweight third person shooter game featuring beautiful girls. You will play the role of a female college student who accidentally joins a mercenary organization due to her disinterest in learning, and carry out a series of thrilling missions to fight against an evil secret organization.

  • Select the necessary equipment before the task begins, and you can use in-game funds to purchase equipment in the store.

  • Experience thrilling gunfights in tasks, including street battles, jungle battles, and wilderness environments.

  • You can obtain supplies from the enemy's backpack.

  • Obtain bonuses by completing tasks and purchase equipment to perform higher difficulty tasks.

Note: This game's account data is stored locally on your device only. No information is sent to any server.
